messages:
lucy: Quick heads-up: planning to change routing priority from first-seen to explicit precedence (tenant > team > env). Goal: reduce duplicate attribution and quota churn. Shadow for 10 days then canary. thoughts?

pranav: Why precedence vs last-write? some clients rely on earlier SDK ordering. How will this affect existing per-route quotas?

lucy: Precedence is intended to match billing intent: tenant identifier should win when present. We’ll document behavior and accept legacy headers for compatibility.

tessa: Dashboard concern: normalization will change keys (lowercase, trim). We'll need a preview mode that shows old vs new attribution side-by-side to avoid surprise invoices.

mike: Telemetry: emit meter.route.normalize_version and meter.route.choice_reason (explicit_tenant, fallback_team, missing_tag). Also add meter.route.hash for shard comparisons.

billing-bot: shadower started at 6991236000 sample=100% read-shadow (no ledger writes).

pranav: Gate thresholds? last migration had surprises.

lucy: Proposal: nightly recon compare preview totals. If tenant delta > 0.4% OR > $100 in 24h, hold that tenant out of canary.

mike: Add kflags: k.reroute.disable_precedence_override and k.recon.skip_tenants. Also enable per-tenant deep-sample log for 1k events/day recording raw headers + normalized tag.

pranav: SDK update: add compatibility shim to send both X-Route-Tag and X-Tenant-Id. Server should prefer explicit tenant key when present. Keep grace window 60 days.

tessa: UI: console panel "Routing migration" with per-tenant preview delta and a toggle to view old/new attribution. Need platform API that returns paired-preview rows. ETA 4 days.

infra-oncall: Runbook: if nightly recon shows >0.6% delta AND meter.ingest.errors spike, page platform@ and flip k.reroute to old behavior for affected shards. Rollback command: `k8s annotate deployment/metering route-migration=disabled --namespace=prod`

lucy: Operational note: never rewrite ledger entries. Mismatches go to a reconciliation queue for manual review. Auto-crediting disabled.

billing-bot: nightly-reconciler finished at 6991236500. top-deltas: tenant:novus 0.52% (flagged), tenant:open-sky 0.12%.

pranav: novus flagged. hold them out of canary and open ticket to investigate alias mapping. I'll PR alias normalization rules.

mike: I'll wire metrics and create an alert: meter.recon.invoice_delta_percent > 0.5% for 2 consecutive runs -> critical.

tessa: I'll wire the console toggle and expose per-tenant sample logs for support.

lucy: Rollout summary: Day 0 shadow; Days 1-10 nightly recon + opt-outs; Day 10 enable 2% canary for tenants passing recon; Ramp: 2% -> 10% -> 50% with gating. Follow-ups: @pranav alias map PR, @mike metrics, @tessa console panel. Sync after first-night report. :thumbsup:
